1.name: Mouhamed Gueye
1.comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

1.name: Henri Veesaar
1.comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

2.name: Devin Carter
2.comment: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

3.name: Yves Missi
3.comment: Missi (knee) won't play in Saturday's game against Atlanta.

3.name: Jordan Poole
3.comment: Poole (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Hawks.

4.name: Dailyn Swain
4.comment: Swain (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Boston.

4.name: Nic Claxton
4.comment: Claxton (hamstring) participated in individual drills Monday morning and hopes to join the team for practice next week, Joe Cowley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

5.name: Jaylon Tyson
5.comment: Tyson (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

5.name: Meleek Thomas
5.comment: Thomas (foot) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

6.name: Santi Aldama
6.comment: Aldama (knee) is listed as out for Friday's game against the Rockets.

6.name: Tarik Biberovic
6.comment: Biberovic (heel) is out for Friday's game against the Rockets.

6.name: Sergio de Larrea
6.comment: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Rockets.

6.name: Dereck Lively II
6.comment: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

7.name: Alpha Diallo
7.comment: Diallo (personal) is doubtful for Friday's game against the Suns.

7.name: Cameron Johnson
7.comment: Johnson (ankle) is expected to play in Friday's game against the Suns, per John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM.

7.name: Spencer Jones
7.comment: Jones (hamstring) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against New Orleans.

7.name: Julian Strawther
7.comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

8.name: Isaiah Joe
8.comment: Joe (hip) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Nets.

8.name: Jalen Duren
8.comment: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

9.name: Gui Santos
9.comment: Santos (knee) is questionable for Friday's game against the Lakers.

9.name: Kristaps Porzingis
9.comment: The Warriors are exploring potential trades involving Porzingis (personal), who remains away from the team indefinitely while dealing with ongoing health concerns, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.

9.name: Moses Moody
9.comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

9.name: Jimmy Butler III
9.comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

10.name: Reed Sheppard
10.comment: Houston picked up Sheppard's (back) fourth-year team option Friday, per Lachard Binkley of SI.com.

10.name: Marcus Smart
10.comment: Smart (forearm) is questionable for Friday's game against the Mavericks.

10.name: Alperen Sengun
10.comment: Sengun (back) is questionable for Friday's game against the Mavericks.

10.name: Steven Adams
10.comment: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could be out "a week or two" due to his right soleus strain, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

11.name: Obi Toppin
11.comment: Toppin (back) is questionable for Friday's game against the Heat.

11.name: T.J. McConnell
11.comment: McConnell (hamstring) is practicing in the G League at Noblesville Boom training camp, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

11.name: Johnny Furphy
11.comment: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

11.name: Andrew Nembhard
11.comment: Nembhard (neck) is listed as probable for Friday's game against Miami.

11.name: Aaron Nesmith
11.comment: Nesmith (hamstring) is probable for Friday's game against the Heat.

11.name: Ivica Zubac
11.comment: Zubac (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.

11.name: Ben Sheppard
11.comment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

11.name: Tyrese Haliburton
11.comment: Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least the next two weeks of action, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

12.name: Rui Hachimura
12.comment: Hachimura (quadriceps) is probable for Friday's game against Minnesota, per Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com.

12.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
12.comment: Niederhauser (foot) had his third-year team option picked up Thursday by the Clippers, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

12.name: Max Strus
12.comment: Strus (foot) is making progress but is set to miss at least one more week, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

12.name: Brandon Ingram
12.comment: Ingram (Achilles) is making progress but is set to miss at least one more week, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

12.name: Bradley Beal
12.comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

12.name: Jordan Miller
12.comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

13.name: Ziaire Williams
13.comment: Williams has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Warriors due to left foot injury management, Mark Medina of TheSportingTribune.com reports.

13.name: Adou Thiero
13.comment: Thiero (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Warriors.

16.name: Anthony Edwards
16.comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

16.name: Donte DiVincenzo
16.comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

17.name: Egor Demin
17.comment: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

17.name: Tyler Bilodeau
17.comment: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Indiana.

18.name: Jose Alvarado
18.comment: Alvarado (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Philadelphia.

19.name: Jonathan Isaac
19.comment: Isaac (knee) is out for Friday's game in Toronto.

19.name: Jalen Suggs
19.comment: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

19.name: Paolo Banchero
19.comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

19.name: Noah Penda
19.comment: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

19.name: Izaiyah Nelson
19.comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

20.name: Jaylen Brown
20.comment: Brown (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Knicks.

20.name: Jabari Walker
20.comment: Walker (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game versus New York.

20.name: Tacko Fall
20.comment: Fall (quadriceps) is out for Wednesday's game in Indiana.

20.name: Dominick Barlow
20.comment: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

20.name: Ariel Hukporti
20.comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

21.name: Oso Ighodaro
21.comment: Ighodaro (oblique) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Denver.

21.name: Mark Williams
21.comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

22.name: Ja Morant
22.comment: Morant has been diagnosed with a Grade 2 left hamstring strain and is expected to miss four weeks, Portland announced Friday.

22.name: Robert Williams III
22.comment: Williams (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against Memphis, Casey Holdahl of the Trail Blazers' official site reports.

22.name: Chris Youngblood
22.comment: Youngblood (ankle/two-way player) is out for Tuesday's game against the Lakers.

22.name: Shaedon Sharpe
22.comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

23.name: Dylan Cardwell
23.comment: Cardwell (calf) will be re-evaluated in one week, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

23.name: Maxime Raynaud
23.comment: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

23.name: Keegan Murray
23.comment: Murray (ankle) will be re-evaluated in 10-to-14 days, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.

23.name: Ben Simmons
23.comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

24.name: Tobias Harris
24.comment: Harris (calf) is listed as out for Saturday's game against Minnesota.

24.name: Jayden Quaintance
24.comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

25.name: Chet Holmgren
25.comment: Holmgren (knee) remains out for Saturday's road game against Houston, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.

25.name: Jalen Williams
25.comment: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

25.name: Alex Caruso
25.comment: Caruso (ankle) is expected to miss time due to an ankle sprain, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

25.name: Thomas Sorber
25.comment: Sorber (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks.

25.name: Nikola Topic
25.comment: Topic (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game in Dallas.

25.name: Cason Wallace
25.comment: Wallace has been diagnosed with a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will require surgery, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

26.name: Lauri Markkanen
26.comment: Markkanen (wrist) is out for Wednesday's tilt against the Spurs.

26.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
26.comment: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

26.name: Trey Alexander
26.comment: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

26.name: Jusuf Nurkic
26.comment: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

27.name: Justin Champagnie
27.comment: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

27.name: Tristan Vukcevic
27.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

27.name: Jamir Watkins
27.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

28.name: Kawhi Leonard
28.comment: Leonard (knee) is expected to be sidelined for at least three to four weeks, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

28.name: Nate Bittle
28.comment: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Magic, Cody Taylor of USA Today reports.

29.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
29.comment: Pippen recorded two points (1-1 FG) across 14 minutes during Thursday's 124-103 win over the Trail Blazers.

29.name: Ty Jerome
29.comment: Jerome (back) is available for Thursday's game at Portland.

29.name: Quinten Post
29.comment: Post (ankle) is doubtful for Friday's game against the Kings.

30.name: Kon Knueppel
30.comment: Knueppel (hamstring) was recalled from the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Friday. He remains out for Friday's contest against the Wizards.

30.name: Coby White
30.comment: Head coach Charles Lee said Monday that White (calf) remains without a timeline for a return, though Lee added that he'll have a better idea of where things stand following the Hornets' two-game road trip, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.

30.name: Grant Williams
30.comment: Williams (hamstring) will be re-evaluated following Charlotte's upcoming two-game road trip, Rod Boone reports.

30.name: Kylan Boswell
30.comment: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.
